subject.title: fix: recover stranded replies in message_tool_only mode (#85714)

question: Should stranded `message_tool_only` finals recover only behind `messages.strandedReplyRecovery`, recover by default through the successor PR, or remain diagnostics-only?
rationale: The open candidates intentionally differ on product/privacy policy, and neither has merged into current main; automation cannot choose the policy by treating one as automatically obsolete.

options.title: Keep Opt-In Recovery
options.body: Continue this PR if maintainers prefer default-off compatibility and privacy posture with explicit operator opt-in.

options.title: Choose Default Recovery
options.body: Close this PR only after maintainers explicitly select and land the default-on successor as the canonical fix.

options.title: Stay Diagnostics-Only
options.body: Close both recovery branches if maintainers decide the strict no-message-call contract should remain warning-only.

recommendation.title: Keep Opt-In Recovery
recommendation.body: Continue this PR if maintainers prefer default-off compatibility and privacy posture with explicit operator opt-in.

likelyOwner.reason: He merged the diagnostics-only baseline and is the clearest history-backed owner for the recovery-vs-privacy policy decision.
